say:1:1029778001:0.text: Long time no see, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! And good to see you too, Chippy and Hammie!
say:1:1029778001:0.male: Long time no see, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! And good to see you too, Chippy and Hammie!
say:1:1029778001:0.female: Long time no see, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! And good to see you too, Chippy and Hammie!

say:3:1029778002:0.text: How have you been? Are you here for the new market? I heard about it, so I brought my little siblings—
say:3:1029778002:0.source_cn: 你们过得怎么样？也来圣石镇玩吗？我听说这里有集市，所以...

say:4:1029778003:1.text: Ravis! Get back here! And don't drag Annia around with you!
say:4:1029778003:1.source_cn: 拉维斯！回来！不许带着安妮尔乱跑！

say:6:1029778004:1.text: Taking care of kids is tough...

say:7:1029778005:1.text: Just hearing those kids scream makes Chippy feel like someone's pounding on his helmet and his head's ringing...
say:7:1029778005:1.source_cn: 满满光是听小孩子尖叫，就感觉头盔好像被敲了好几下，脑袋...

say:8:1029778006:1.text: Well, this is a rare occasion, and I don't often have time to take them out.
say:8:1029778006:1.source_cn: 毕竟我是姐姐嘛，平时也没什么时间带他们出来玩。

say:9:1029778007:0.text: They're usually well-behaved, but the second they're somewhere this exciting... Ravis!
say:9:1029778007:0.source_cn: 平时他们也挺懂事的，但一到了这种热闹的地方，就会有点—...

say:12:1029778008:0.text: After a whole lot of chaos, Marilee finally wrangles the kids, gives them a proper scolding, and comes back to us out of breath.
say:12:1029778008:0.source_cn: 一番鸡飞狗跳后，梅瑞特总算把弟弟妹妹抓住，好好教训了一...

say:14:1029778009:1.text: Sorry you had to see all that... So, what did you need from me?
say:14:1029778009:1.source_cn: 让你们见笑了……对了，你们找我有什么事？

choice_prompt:15:1029778009.text: Sorry you had to see all that... So, what did you need from me?
choice_prompt:15:1029778009.source_cn: 让你们见笑了……对了，你们找我有什么事？

say:16:1029778010:1.text: A festival? That's great news! Ravis and Annia will love it, and I bet Grandpa and Grandma will want to join too!
say:16:1029778010:1.source_cn: 庆典？那太好了，不仅拉维斯和安妮尔喜欢，爷爷奶奶应该也...

say:17:1029778011:1.text: We could even bring some coins to pick up a few things at the market...
say:17:1029778011:1.source_cn: 正好还能带上钱，在集市上添置点东西……

say:18:1029778012:1.text: No—better yet, I can sell some of my hunted game too... That's it!
say:18:1029778012:1.source_cn: 不、不止，还能去卖点我的猎物……就这么办！

say:19:1029778013:1.text: Ravis, Annia—come on! We're heading back for now!
say:19:1029778013:1.source_cn: 拉维斯，安妮尔，跟我来，我们先回去一趟！
